listitem.para: Whether to negotiate the IKEv2 CHILD_SA_PFS_INFO_SUPPORTED notification (draft-ietf-ipsecme-child-pfs-info) during IKE_SA_INIT. When both peers support it, the key exchange method to use when rekeying the Child SA is agreed during IKE_AUTH.
This is a global option, and not a per-connection option, because the notification is exchanged in IKE_SA_INIT, before a responder knows which connection the IKE SA will be using.
